+import numpy as np
+import mw_tool
+
+
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.npz"
+OUTPUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def report(s, label):
+    st = s.state()
+    print(
+        label,
+        len(s.actions),
+        "mocap", np.round(st["mocap_pos"], 3),
+        "tcp", np.round(st["tcp"], 3),
+        "obj", np.round(st["object_pos"], 3),
+        "grip", round(st["gripper_opening"], 3),
+        "dist", round(st["obj_to_target"], 3),
+        "success", st["success"],
+        flush=True,
+    )
+
+
+def move(s, target, grip, max_steps=120, tol=0.003):
+    target = np.asarray(target, float)
+    for _ in range(max_steps):
+        p = s.state()["mocap_pos"]
+        err = target - p
+        if np.linalg.norm(err) < tol:
+            break
+        a = np.r_[np.clip(err / 0.01, -1, 1), grip]
+        s.step(a)
+    for _ in range(10):
+        s.step([0, 0, 0, grip])
+
+
+def main():
+    s = mw_tool.Session(INSTANCE)
+    report(s, "start")
+    obj = s.state()["object_pos"]
+    move(s, [obj[0], obj[1], 0.20], -1)
+    report(s, "above")
+    move(s, [obj[0], obj[1], 0.075], -1)
+    report(s, "down")
+    for _ in range(35):
+        s.step([0, 0, 0, 1])
+    report(s, "close")
+    move(s, [obj[0], obj[1], 0.24], 1)

+    report(s, "carry")
+    move(s, [goal[0], goal[1], 0.075], 1)
+    report(s, "lower")
+    for _ in range(30):
+        s.step([0, 0, 0, -1])
+    report(s, "release")
+    s.save_trajectory(path=OUTPUT)
+    print(s.replay(np.array(s.actions)))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
